title: Share of US families homeschooling: before, during, and after the pandemic

source.name: Pre-pandemic baseline: National Household Education Survey (NHES). 2020/2023: Household Pulse Survey
source.publisher: National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) / U.S. Census Bureau

notes: 2019 figure (2.8%) is NCES's pre-pandemic National Household Education Survey estimate, the benchmark the Census Bureau itself uses when reporting Household Pulse Survey results. 2020 (11.1%, fall wave) and 2023 (5.4%, May wave) are from the Census Bureau's Household Pulse Survey, which began in April 2020 specifically to track pandemic-era shifts and has continued periodically since. Two different survey instruments measuring the same concept -- both cited here for their own periods since NHES was not fielded in the same way during the pandemic's acute phase.
